REASON FOR VISIT: Follow-up for hypertension management, 6 weeks after starting lisinopril 10mg daily.

INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient reports good medication tolerance, no dizziness, no cough, no swelling. Adherent to daily dosing.

VITALS: BP 122/76, HR 72, Temp 98.2F, RR 14.

PHYSICAL EXAM: No lower extremity edema. Heart regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs. Lungs clear bilaterally. No abnormal findings noted.

ASSESSMENT: Poorly controlled hypertension requiring urgent escalation of therapy.

PLAN: Add second antihypertensive agent and schedule urgent cardiology referral.
